items.description: An abattoir in Francistown. It is part of Botswana's beef-processing chain.
A coal project in Botswana's coal sector. It reflects the country's energy and mining ambitions.
A garment factory in Gaborone. It adds textile production to the city's economy.
An agro-industry project in the Tuli Block. It connects farming with processing and trade.
An airport logistics hub in Maun. It supports tourism freight and regional movement.
A mineral exploration project in Botswana. It reflects ongoing prospecting in the country's resource sector.
A major rock art site in northwestern Botswana. It is one of the country's most important heritage places.
Ruins of a former stone settlement in eastern Botswana. The site reflects the area's early political history.
An archaeological hill site linked to the ancient Toutswe culture. It is an important part of Botswana's precolonial past.
Large rock footprints linked to local origin legends. The site is a well-known part of Botswana's oral history.
A mission station linked to David Livingstone's work in Botswana. It remains a key colonial-era heritage site.
The remains of the old settlement at Palapye. The site preserves ruins from an important chapter in eastern Botswana's history.
